title: Triggering an On-Demand Scan for Active Directory

blocks.text: After you configure an Active Directory (AD) domain for scanning, the scan is triggered at the scheduled time. If you need to immediately scan an AD domain for risks and view the report, you can manually trigger an on-demand scan.
To trigger an on-demand AD scan:

blocks.item: Go to ITDR > Manage > Active Directory Posture.
Locate the AD domain for which you want to manually scan, and click the Trigger a new scan icon.
In the confirmation window, click OK.
The scan is triggered for the selected AD domain. After the scan is complete, you can view the results on the Active Directory Posture dashboard.
